eventMetadata.context_description: Recent ensemble forecasts from global and regional models, including those aligned with INMET guidance, indicate a daily maximum near 25–26°C for São Paulo on August 21, 2026, under partly cloudy conditions with moderate westerly winds. This positioning reflects a post-frontal cooling trend after earlier-week highs near 30°C+, with reduced solar insolation from increased cloud cover and drier subtropical air limiting further warming. Traders differentiate the tightly bunched 25°C, 26°C, and 27°C outcomes primarily through model spread on afternoon boundary-layer mixing and exact timing of any clearing, as urban station measurements (e.g., Mirante de Santana) can vary by 1°C due to localized heat retention or brief wind shifts. Historical August climatology supports a typical peak of 23–25°C, anchoring sentiment around these central values ahead of final observational confirmation.
